create a function that applies solarization to a batch of images with a configurable threshold using solarize
create a function that randomly flips images left or right in a batch using random_flip
create a Checkpointer instance to save and load experiment checkpoints at a given directory
save an experiment checkpoint with state, step, and rng using maybe_save_checkpoint on the Checkpointer
load a previously saved checkpoint from disk using maybe_load_checkpoint on the Checkpointer
load checkpoint data from a file path using the standalone load_checkpoint function
configure checkpointing with a directory, filename, and save interval via the Checkpointer constructor
load an ImageNet dataset split with preprocessing, sharding, and batching for JAX training
normalize image tensors using ImageNet mean and standard deviation statistics with JAX
transpose image batches from NHWC to NCHW format for TPU training performance
convert a string like TRAIN or VALID into a Split enum for dataset loading
get the number of examples for a given ImageNet dataset split like TRAIN or TEST
compute top-k classification accuracy from logits and labels using JAX
compute softmax cross entropy loss from logits and one-hot labels with configurable reduction
l2 normalize a JAX tensor along a specified axis with numerical stability
compute BYOL regression loss as squared L2 distance between l2-normalized vectors
compute l2 weight regularization for model parameters excluding biases and norm layers
build a Haiku MLP module with one hidden layer, batch normalization, and ReLU activation for BYOL projection heads
build a configurable ResNet backbone with block groups, batch norm, and optional bottleneck blocks using Haiku
build a lightweight TinyResNet with minimal channels for fast local testing and development runs
build a ResNet50 model with bottleneck blocks using the standard 3-4-6-3 block group configuration
review the check_length utility function that validates sequence arguments must be exactly length 4

create an optax gradient transformation that rescales updates according to the LARS algorithm with momentum support

create a filter function that excludes bias and normalization weights from optimizer updates by checking parameter paths
review the LARS optimizer implementation including weight decay, momentum, and LARS adaptation filter configuration

compute the cosine decayed value from an initial value given a global step and max steps
refactor the learning_schedule function to support a different warmup strategy beyond linear warmup
review the target_ema function and verify the cosine decay formula for EMA scheduling
